context._note: window = session context. Template default for new installs should be 200000 unless overridden. warnPct soft nudge; gatePct hard block on NEW source Edit/Write. Prefer /synthesize + /clear (handoff) over compact near gate. Checkpoint docs/** never gated.

delivery._note: Agent-active ETA uses phaseHours by size tag. Waiting-on-human pauses ETA; after staleAfterHours status becomes WAITING_STALE.

sprint._note: Sprint layer (/sprint). defaultCapacity = points for first sprint before velocity exists.
